fortress.definition: Every app of one household joined with the same phrase. Its members see the state and the log of every app in it.

th.singular: ป้อมปราการ
th.plural: ป้อมปราการ

instance.definition: One running copy of an app on one device.

member.definition: An instance inside a fortress or group. Removing it puts that one instance out.

permission.definition: An action one app may start in another, such as asking for a backup or running a job. On by default and switched off one by one. Seeing needs none. The English word also names file and system permissions, so translations are held to the forbidden variants alone.

relay.definition: The server members talk through when they cannot reach each other directly.

backup.definition: A saved copy that can be restored.

th.singular: ข้อมูลสำรอง
th.plural: ข้อมูลสำรอง

pairing.definition: Linking instances through the phrase so they trust each other.

phrase.definition: The twelve words an instance joins a fortress or group with, and the only way in. There is one phrase, never a phrase per fortress, so it carries no other name.

forbidden: วลีป้อมปราการ

job.definition: Work set up once that an app then runs by itself, on a schedule or on demand.
